name: Collibra MCP
description: Search the Collibra data catalog and business glossary, trace data lineage, and look up governed asset details from AI assistants over Collibra's MCP server.

skills.name: Data Asset Discovery
skills.description: Answers natural-language questions about available data assets and runs wildcard keyword searches across the Collibra catalog.

skills.name: Business Glossary Search
skills.description: Answers questions about business terms and definitions and traces a term back to its connected physical data assets.

skills.name: Technical Lineage
skills.description: Gets upstream sources and downstream consumers for a data entity and returns the logic of individual data transformations.

skills.name: Asset Creation And Editing
skills.description: Creates assets of any type and edits attributes, relations, tags, and steward or owner responsibilities on existing assets.

skills.name: Data Contracts
skills.description: Lists data contracts, initializes new contract assets, and downloads or uploads contract manifests for data product ports.
